# myQSL Cloudflare production operations

Production setup, deployment, verification, and feature enablement flows for myQSL.

## Credential boundaries

Deployment credentials, Worker runtime secrets, and application credentials have separate trust boundaries.

<!-- mermaid:id=credential-boundaries -->
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  accTitle: Credential boundaries
  accDescr: Cloudflare API token goes to GitHub Actions and local Wrangler&#59; Worker runtime secrets stay in Cloudflare&#59; Agent and email credentials are only enabled when their feature is enabled.
  operator["Operator Cloudflare + GitHub"]
  class operator actor
  deployToken["Deploy API Token CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"]
  class deployToken deploy
  githubSecrets["GitHub production secrets Token + Account ID"]
  class githubSecrets deploy
  actions["GitHub Actions preflight → migrate → deploy"]
  class actions process
  workerSecrets["Worker runtime secrets D1_REST_API_TOKEN RATE_LIMIT_SALT"]
  class workerSecrets secret
  appSecrets["Optional app secrets Access / QRZ / Resend / PII"]
  class appSecrets optional
  worker["Cloudflare Worker myqsl"]
  class worker platform
  operator -->|create + store safely| deployToken
  deployToken -->|GitHub Environment| githubSecrets
  githubSecrets -->|CI/CD only| actions
  actions -->|Wrangler deploy| worker
  operator -->|wrangler secret put| workerSecrets
  workerSecrets -->|encrypted runtime| worker
  operator -->|only before enabling feature| appSecrets
  appSecrets -->|runtime only| worker
classDef actor fill:#fff7ed,stroke:#f97316,stroke-width:2px,color:#7c2d12
classDef deploy fill:#eff6ff,stroke:#3b82f6,stroke-width:2px,color:#1e3a8a
classDef process fill:#ecfeff,stroke:#0891b2,stroke-width:2px,color:#164e63
classDef secret fill:#fef2f2,stroke:#dc2626,stroke-width:2px,color:#7f1d1d
classDef optional fill:#f5f3ff,stroke:#7c3aed,stroke-width:2px,color:#4c1d95
classDef platform fill:#f0fdf4,stroke:#16a34a,stroke-width:2px,color:#14532d
%% portable-canonical-v2:
```

## First production deployment

A fail-closed deployment sequence for the current main branch workflow.

<!-- mermaid:id=production-deployment -->
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  accTitle: First production deployment
  accDescr: Prepare Cloudflare resources, configure GitHub and Worker secrets, run strict preflight, migrate D1, build, deploy, and perform smoke tests.
  prepare["1 · Prepare Account ID + API token D1 / R2 / domain"]
  class prepare step
  github["2 · GitHub production secrets"]
  class github step
  runtime["3 · Worker D1 token + salt"]
  class runtime step
  vars["4 · Runtime vars Account ID + D1 ID"]
  class vars step
  preflight["5 · Strict preflight PRODUCTION_CONFIG_OK"]
  class preflight gate
  migration["6 · Remote D1 migrations apply"]
  class migration data
  build["7 · Build Web assets + Worker"]
  class build build
  deploy["8 · Wrangler deploy main → Cloudflare"]
  class deploy deploy
  smoke["9 · Smoke test healthz / Access / print"]
  class smoke verify
  prepare --> github
  github --> runtime
  runtime --> vars
  vars --> preflight
  preflight -->|pass| migration
  migration --> build
  build --> deploy
  deploy --> smoke
classDef step fill:#eff6ff,stroke:#2563eb,stroke-width:2px,color:#1e3a8a
classDef gate fill:#fff7ed,stroke:#ea580c,stroke-width:3px,color:#7c2d12
classDef data fill:#ecfdf5,stroke:#059669,stroke-width:2px,color:#064e3b
classDef build fill:#f5f3ff,stroke:#7c3aed,stroke-width:2px,color:#4c1d95
classDef deploy fill:#fef2f2,stroke:#dc2626,stroke-width:2px,color:#7f1d1d
classDef verify fill:#f0fdf4,stroke:#16a34a,stroke-width:2px,color:#14532d
%% portable-canonical-v2:
```

## Enable features and recover safely

Keep high-risk features disabled until their external credentials and acceptance tests are complete.

<!-- mermaid:id=enable-and-recover -->
```mermaid
flowchart TB
  accTitle: Enable features and recover safely
  accDescr: Start with print only, then validate Agent, then validate email, with a feature-flag rollback path at every stage.
  baseline["Baseline live Agent OFF · Email OFF · Print ON"]
  class baseline safe
  owner["Owner Access + /readyz 管理台登录与数据读写"]
  class owner verify
  print["Print acceptance PDF / QR / R2 / 实体尺寸"]
  class print verify
  agentPrep["Agent preparation Access Service Auth + device token WSJT-X 2237 / N1MM 12060"]
  class agentPrep controlled
  agentOn["Enable Agent 单设备灰度 + 断网补传"]
  class agentOn controlled
  emailPrep["Email preparation QRZ + PII key + Resend + webhook"]
  class emailPrep controlled
  emailOn["Enable Email 只发测试邮箱 → 检查回执"]
  class emailOn controlled
  rollback["Rollback 关闭 feature flag 保留数据与幂等墓碑"]
  class rollback rollback
  baseline --> owner
  owner --> print
  print -->|通过后| agentPrep
  agentPrep -->|认证 + 真机通过| agentOn
  agentOn -->|稳定观察后| emailPrep
  emailPrep -->|回执 + 退信通过| emailOn
  agentOn -->|异常| rollback
  emailOn -->|异常| rollback
  rollback -->|重新部署| baseline
classDef safe fill:#ecfdf5,stroke:#059669,stroke-width:3px,color:#064e3b
classDef verify fill:#eff6ff,stroke:#2563eb,stroke-width:2px,color:#1e3a8a
classDef controlled fill:#fff7ed,stroke:#ea580c,stroke-width:2px,color:#7c2d12
classDef rollback fill:#fef2f2,stroke:#dc2626,stroke-width:3px,color:#7f1d1d
```
